description:
Create a new Project Vendor.

#### Country and State codes
The `country_code` and `state_code` parameter values must conform to the ISO-3166 Alpha-2 specification.
See [Working with Country Codes](/documentation/country-codes) for additional information.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
The normal view provides what is shown below.
The extended view is the same as the normal view but includes children_count, legal_name, parent, and bidding.
The default view is normal.

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description: If true, validations are run for the corresponding Configurable Field Set.

abbreviated_name.description: Short form of the vendor name.

business_phone.description: Business phone number for the vendor.

business_register.description: Business register details for the vendor. When provided, both type and identifier are required. A 400 error is returned if only one is present.

identifier.description: Business register identifier (e.g. ABN = 11 digits, EIN = 9 digits).

mobile_phone.description: Mobile phone number for the vendor.

origin_id.description: Identifier for this vendor in an external system, such as an ERP integration.

origin_data.description: Arbitrary data from an external system, stored as a string.

origin_code.description: Code for this vendor in an external system, such as an ERP integration.

parent_id.description: Parent Vendor ID. Cannot be the same as ID. Only two levels of hierarchy are supported (parent/child).

primary_contact_id.description: ID of the contact to set as the vendor's primary contact.

trade_name.description: Vendor's Trade Name, also known as Doing Business As (DBA).
